subject.title: feat(agents): add iteration budget for agent loop safety

question: Should `maxToolCallingRounds` ship as a built-in OpenClaw-only setting that rejects Codex and other plugin harness runs, or must a generic harness capability contract exist before this public config is accepted?
rationale: The patch adds permanent public config and an agent-core package subpath while intentionally making configured non-built-in harness runs fail before their model call.

options.title: Ship built-in-only first
options.body: Approve the documented fail-closed behavior for non-built-in harnesses, require exact-head proof and clear diagnostics, and consider future harness support separately.

options.title: Add harness capability contract
options.body: Hold the config until agent harnesses can explicitly advertise and implement equivalent round-limit semantics.

options.title: Pause the public setting
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open and defer this branch if maintainers do not want a built-in-only safety control.

recommendation.title: Ship built-in-only first
recommendation.body: Approve the documented fail-closed behavior for non-built-in harnesses, require exact-head proof and clear diagnostics, and consider future harness support separately.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current integration commit and explicitly narrowed the config and harness semantics on this PR.
